title: Budafoki MTE's style of play in defensive transition
subtitle: Budafoki MTE | Hungarian NB II 2025/2026

kpis.name: Time to defensive action after att. half turnover (s)
kpis.description: Average time that it took a team to make a defensive action after losing the possession of the ball in the attacking half in open play per match.
kpis.display_name: Time to defensive action after att. half turnover (s)

kpis.name: Time to defensive action after own-half turnover (s)
kpis.description: Average time that it took a team to make a defensive action after losing the possession of the ball in their own half in open play per match.
kpis.display_name: Time to defensive action after own-half turnover (s)

kpis.name: Recoveries within 5s %
kpis.description: Percentage of ball recoveries made by a team within 5 seconds after losing the possession of the ball in open play per match.

kpis.name: Opp. Possessions to final third within 10s after att. half turnover %
kpis.description: Percentage of opponent possessions that begin with a loss in open play in the attacking half by a team and result in the opponent entering the final third within 10 seconds per match.
kpis.display_name: Opp. Possessions to final third within 10s after att. half turnover %
